fight_summary.summary: The reports reconstruct an objective unlock, contested central-lane fighting and movement toward a side room. Sampled control percentages remain zero for both teams; the blue round tally of one to zero is not a fight result. ROXY is eliminated with ALPHARI credited, while the other four POV players are reported alive in their final samples. Full starting team counts, prior engagement, enemy resources and subsequent objective ownership are unknown. Some opening health is already depleted, so equal initial conditions cannot be assumed.

confirmed_facts.claim: Original support2 reports objective unlock with both control percentages zero; original tank reports sampled CONTESTED text.
Original tank and support2 report reciprocal Kiriko save notifications for ROXY; exact triggering effects are unresolved.
Original tank reports movement into a side room, ammunition replenishment, a nearby enemy Mauga, sampled STUNNED text and resumed firing. Exact contact and stun cause are unknown.

The original tank death HUD and all four other reports corroborate displayed ALPHARI elimination credit for ROXY. Each other POV reports its player alive in the final sample; this does not establish full team counts.

findings.claim: Avoidable overcommitment or trapping in the side room is not established.
findings.player_information: Nearby opponents, own health, damage indicators and later stun text are reported. Safe escape routes, enemy cooldown knowledge and calls are unknown; room geometry restricts objective sight. Broadcast information is not automatically native player knowledge; audio is unavailable.
findings.alternative_action: Holding nearer cover before entry or taking another retreat route is a candidate only if visible, reachable and safer. Those conditions are not established.
findings.plausible_consequence: Lower exposure might preserve health for reloading, but another route might expose ROXY to more fire or reduce support access.
findings.causal_reasoning: Entry precedes health loss, and later movement precedes reload, stun and death. This shows pressure without establishing avoidable exposure or a caused team loss.
findings.alternative_explanation: The later run may be a necessary retreat defeated by pursuit or displacement; support1 uncertainty does not negate the observed running camera.

findings.claim: Avoidable exposure or abandonment of ROXY is not established.
findings.player_information: Enemies, ROXY partly blocking the lane, own damage feedback and column cover are reported. Elevation cause, escape ability availability and calls are unknown. Broadcast information is not automatically native player knowledge; audio is unavailable.
findings.alternative_action: Earlier column cover could be considered if reachable before damage; the samples do not establish an earlier safe timing. Continued exposure to assist ROXY is not shown to be survivable.
findings.plausible_consequence: Cover might preserve health while reducing firing pressure. Staying engaged could add pressure at risk of elimination; no save is guaranteed.
findings.causal_reasoning: Reported firing and close combat precede severe health loss and retreat. Reduced later pressure is possible, but forced movement and damage remain unresolved, so a bad decision is not established.
findings.alternative_explanation: Enemy damage or displacement may force the elevation change and retreat; the sheltered passage may be an appropriate survival choice.

findings.claim: Insufficient pressure or a mistimed defensive action is not established.
findings.player_information: Nearby combat, own damage and some ROXY critical markers are reported. Hero, ability identities, shot impacts, native marker access and calls are unknown. Broadcast information is not automatically native player knowledge; audio is unavailable.
findings.alternative_action: A clearer firing angle is a candidate only if safe and available against a visible target. No specific alternative ability use can be established with hero and resources unresolved.
findings.plausible_consequence: A clearer angle might add pressure but increase exposure. Unknown impacts prevent predicting a prevented elimination.
findings.causal_reasoning: Repeated firing, ammunition replenishment and a damage-related position change do not support inactivity. No feasible better shot sequence or ability timing is established.
findings.alternative_explanation: Occlusion, incoming fire or necessary defensive ability use may explain the observed pattern.

findings.claim: Avoidable healing interruption or a missed rescue ability is not established.
findings.player_information: Forward allies and critical markers are reported with cover and effects obscuring recipients. Fuel and ammunition HUD are reported; exact rescue availability and native marker access are uncertain. Broadcast information is not automatically native player knowledge; audio is unavailable.
findings.alternative_action: Maintaining a clearer healing angle could help if fuel, cover and enemy threats permit. A safe earlier position or available rescue ability is not established.
findings.plausible_consequence: A clearer angle might improve delivery, but incoming pressure could still exceed healing and repositioning could expose the support.
findings.causal_reasoning: Movement, reloads, healing-directed shots and an unidentified cooldown transition are reported. Sampling cannot establish a harmful pause or quantify healing delivery; the later death alone proves no failure.
findings.alternative_explanation: Cover, reload needs, fuel constraints or displacement may disrupt access despite reasonable support play.

findings.claim: Harmful healing-versus-kunai allocation or mistimed protection is not established.
findings.player_information: Allies, some critical markers and doorway opponents are reported; barriers restrict sight. Team resource knowledge, communications and a feasible later save window are unknown. Broadcast information is not automatically native player knowledge; audio is unavailable.
findings.alternative_action: Prioritizing healing toward a visible critical ally is a candidate when sight permits, but no harmful interruption is established. Holding earlier protection for later is not shown feasible without losing its earlier benefit.
findings.plausible_consequence: Different allocation might alter healing or enemy pressure; travel, cooldowns and burst prevent predicting survival.
findings.causal_reasoning: Healing trails, interspersed throws and a credited save precede elimination. These prove neither optimal continuous healing nor a missed save; prior cooldown use may constrain later options.
findings.alternative_explanation: Earlier protection may answer immediate danger; later burst or sight restrictions may defeat available healing. The save notification does not establish later safety.

tank.summary: ROXY advances, later moves into a room under pressure, reloads and is eliminated after a sampled stun. Avoidability and a feasible safer route remain unresolved.

dps1.summary: KANEKI engages, takes severe damage and reaches cover alive. A safer earlier opportunity and causal abandonment are not established.

dps2.summary: PINEAPPLE fires repeatedly and survives damage. Hero, abilities and impacts are unresolved; no supported mistake follows from unknown output.

support1.summary: MEWTWO follows and fires toward the pressured group. Delivery, movement causes and cooldown effects remain unresolved, preventing a supported healing-failure finding.

support2.summary: MMONK directs healing and receives a corroborated save notification. Protection effects and later save feasibility remain unresolved, so no supported mistake is established.

alternative_explanations: Enemy pressure, pursuit and the sampled stun could explain ROXY’s elimination despite support effects. Exact damage and healing sources are unresolved.

The side-room run may be an attempted disengagement and reload rather than an avoidable trapping decision. Tank movement-camera observations and support1 uncertainty about displacement are compatible.
KANEKI’s severe damage and unresolved elevation change may force a retreat. PINEAPPLE’s obscured shot impacts do not establish inadequate pressure.
Support effects may be limited by cover, projectile travel, cooldowns or incoming burst. An eventual death does not establish a missed feasible save.
The recording may end during an unresolved fight; tank elimination and the round tally do not establish the winner.

verdict.summary: The reports corroborate ROXY’s elimination and earlier save notifications, but do not establish a complete fight outcome or an avoidable causal mistake by any player. All five receive no_supported_mistake, which expresses insufficient evidence rather than proof of flawless play.
